idea-plugin.name: Currency Minor Unit Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the money lines that send the wrong amount to a payment API: the x100 that charges 100x in JPY, the toFixed(2) that truncates KWD, and the currency codes that stopped being legal tender.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Currency Minor Unit Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 24 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/currency-minor-unit-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/currency-minor-unit-lint

action.text: Currency Minor Unit Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Currency Minor Unit Lint on the file in the editor
